page_title: DishRoll — AI Meal Planner | Weekly Meal Planning App

sources.entry: DishRoll - AI-powered weekly meal planner that generates personalised 7-day menus based on dietary needs, cuisine preferences, and grocery budget.

summary.name: DishRoll
summary.one_liner: DishRoll is an AI meal planner that builds a personalised week of meals, recipes and a shopping list based on your tastes, household and budget.
use_cases: Generating a grocery list from a meal plan
Finding recipes that fit a dietary need
Avoiding impulse buys by planning ahead
summary.what_it_does: DishRoll generates a personalised 7-day meal plan from a description of your tastes, household and budget. Each meal comes with step-by-step recipes. It also produces a smart shopping list for the week. An AI chef chat lets you ask questions at any time. The interface shows a calendar of weeks where you can tap to plan each one.
notable: AI-generated 7-day menus tuned to dietary needs, cuisines and budget
AI Chef Chat for open questions
caveats: Page shows 'FREE · 5 trial left', suggesting a limited trial; paid tiers are not described on the page
Page text does not state details of platform support beyond the web app
